title: Ang Daigdig Ko'y Ikaw
creator: Efren Reyes
description: A romantic comedy in which Roman, a truck driver, crosses paths with Vicky, a runaway heiress. It was the first film to pair Poe with Susan Roces, whom he later married.
subject: Romance; Comedy; With Susan Roces

title: Tanging Ikaw
description: Poe and Susan Roces star together again, in the year of their wedding.
subject: Romance; With Susan Roces

title: Tatak ng Alipin
description: One of the 1970s films that built Poe's image as the underdog who stands up for himself.
subject: Drama

title: Tutubing Kalabaw, Tutubing Karayom
description: Poe plays Berting, a man from the countryside who comes to the rescue of a friend and goes after the people who wronged her. Child star Niño Muhlach co-stars.
subject: Action; Drama

title: Ang Maestro
creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)
description: Poe directs himself as Maestro Carpio, a master swordsman bound by a promise to teach only one student.
subject: Action; Directed by FPJ

title: Isang Bala Ka Lang!
description: An action film that was followed by a sequel in 1996.
subject: Action

title: Isa-Isa Lang!
description: Poe plays Carding Briñas in this action film.
subject: Action

description: Poe is Sgt. Isagani Guerrero, a policeman. Two sequels followed, in 1989 and 1990.
subject: Action; Lawman roles; Kapag Puno Na ang Salop series

description: A policeman takes the law into his own hands to avenge the killing of his family.
subject: Action; Lawman roles

title: Dito sa Pitong Gatang
creator: Pablo Santiago
description: Poe plays Berting Cayabyab, chairman of Barangay Pitong Gatang in Tondo, who falls for Lambing (Nanette Medved), the chairman of the barangay next door.

description: Poe plays Mike Bautista, opposite Alice Dixson and Vandolph.
